title: prefs: Convert most RTP dissectors to use "auto" PT preferences
description:
Similar to commit 2eb7b05b8c9c6408268f0d1e81f0a18a02610f1c,
replace the RTP payload type preferences with automatic
dissectors.

This reduces the number of preference module callbacks.

commits_data.message:
prefs: Convert most RTP dissectors to use "auto" PT preferences

Similar to commit 2eb7b05b8c9c6408268f0d1e81f0a18a02610f1c,
replace the RTP payload type preferences with automatic
dissectors.

This reduces the number of preference module callbacks.
